query: Which minimum data‑minimization rules, retention exceptions for audio/qualitative data, access controls, reidentification key governance, and alert‑pipeline test plans will we adopt?

response.query: Which minimum data‑minimization rules, retention exceptions for audio/qualitative data, access controls, reidentification key governance, and alert‑pipeline test plans will we adopt?
response.answer: Minimum data-minimization rules will prioritize data reduction; retention exceptions for audio/qualitative data may allow longer storage for critical research; access controls will be stringent to protect sensitive information; reidentification key governance will ensure secure management; alert-pipeline test plans will be regularly updated.
